title: The Lady in the Car with Glasses and a Gun
writer: Sébastien Japrisot, Anatole Litvak, Richard Harris
actors: Samantha Eggar, Oliver Reed, Stéphane Audran
plot: A secretary takes her boss's car for the holiday in the Mediterranean, oddly retracing a journey she has not taken, and is recognized by people she has not met before. Soon, things get serious.
